statements.status_notes: Rechecked the upstream advisory on 2026-09-17: affected versions belong only to github.com/containerd/containerd/v2, not the major-v1 module. Grype 0.118.0 matches the unreviewed Go vulnerability database entry against v1.7.35 with an unknown version constraint. Existing v1.7.33 coverage is retained.
statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-50195 affects containerd release lines using the github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 Go module path. The subject is the major-v1 module github.com/containerd/containerd at v1.7.33 or v1.7.35. Go modules with major versions two and later use distinct module paths, so the affected /v2 code is not present in this package version.
statements.action_statement: Retire this statement when scanner matching no longer maps github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 advisories to the major-v1 module. Re-review if the subject changes to the /v2 module.
